tasks.title: Build the feature-level walkthrough controller and tour map
tasks.scope: Create a DOM-only controller and concise, selector-based tour map covering the shell plus meaningful feature areas on every app route. It must move between routes, skip unavailable conditional targets, use Back/Next/Close/Escape, return focus, and expose one highlighted target plus a short adjacent dialog at a time.
tasks.verification: Prove tour-map route coverage, finite forward traversal, safe missing-target skipping, and pure controller module syntax.

tasks.title: Wire the header trigger and focused overlay presentation
tasks.scope: Place a Walkthrough button immediately after New study, wire it to the controller, and render a dimmed/blurred four-pane spotlight with an anchored 2–3 sentence dialog. Preserve Explain this step and existing guided walkthrough behavior.
tasks.verification: Inspect the button order and controller wiring, confirm the backdrop excludes only the target rectangle, and verify compact-screen dialog placement remains clamped to the viewport.

tasks.title: Verify the focused tour in the shipped artifact
tasks.scope: Add focused tests for route coverage and navigation invariants, rebuild the single-file artifact, run the full JavaScript suite, and live-check launch, highlighting, and movement to a subsequent feature.
tasks.verification: Full suite passes; built artifact contains no static imports; the local tour opens from the header and its Next action changes the highlighted feature or route.
